factories.name: new_search_articles_step
factories.description: Search one page of articles through NewsAPI's everything endpoint by keyword, title or body fields, sources, domains, language, and publication window, newest or most relevant first.

inputSchema.description: SearchArticlesInput selects one page of NewsAPI's everything search. Query, Sources, or Domains must be set. Empty fields are not sent, so NewsAPI applies its own defaults.

domains.description: Domains restricts results to these domains, such as techcrunch.com.

excludeDomains.description: ExcludeDomains removes results from these domains.

from.description: From is the oldest publication time, as a date such as 2026-01-05, a UTC time such as 2026-01-05T07:00:00, or an RFC 3339 time. Empty uses the oldest article the plan allows.

language.description: Language is one of Languages. Empty returns articles in every language.

page.description: Page is the 1-based page number. Zero selects page 1.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of articles per page, from 1 through 100. Zero uses NewsAPI's default of 100.

query.description: Query is NewsAPI's keyword expression, up to 500 characters. It supports quoted phrases, + and - prefixes, AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses. The connector form-encodes it.

searchIn.description: SearchIn limits Query matching to title, description, or content. Empty searches all three.

sortBy.description: SortBy is publishedAt (newest first), relevancy, or popularity. Empty uses NewsAPI's default, publishedAt.

sources.description: Sources lists up to 20 NewsAPI source IDs, such as bbc-news.

to.description: To is the newest publication time in the same forms. Empty means now.
